The detector's only validated edge is absolute-trend gating for drawdown control; momentum ranks are a focus lens only, and the rotation margin (0.595) is not wide enough to call a confirmed handoff. Track record (n=76, dir_accuracy 0.526) is effectively coin-flip on direction, so conviction should default low.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the AI Infrastructure challenger (score 1.745, durability 0.66, margin 0.595 from leader Memory/HBM) CLOSES the rotation gap to the leader and takes over rank 1 WITHOUT the leader falling out of the eligible set — a confirmed handoff would need AI Infra to hold rank 1 while Memory/HBM loses eligibility or drops below rank 3. Retire this watch if the margin widens back above 0.8 and Memory/HBM confirms leadership for another 10 sessions.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Memory/HBM is the ranked leader with the highest score (2.34) and healthy breadth (0.75), eligible under the trend gate. The absolute-trend gate is the one validated risk-control leg, and this theme passes it — so a modest lean in the direction of prevailing leadership is defensible, not as a return forecast but as alignment with the trend-following discipline the detector actually supports. Durability is moderate (0.68), hurst mixed, crowding absent (z 0.53).
evidence: gate_helps=true (validated drawdown control on this market)
theses.dissent: Momentum rank has ~0 rank-IC — leadership here is an attention signal, and the theme could just be the most extended recent winner. Hurst is mixed (not cleanly trending), and the 0.595 rotation margin is thin enough that leadership could revert without a structural break.

Crowding is flagged (z 1.82) — this is a size-down caution only, NOT a fade, so a lean stays directionally positive but humble.

On the detector's own terms — trend health and staying power, the one validated edge — this is one of the healthiest trend candidates, even though it sits mid-leaderboard at rank 5 (score 1.083, not crowded, z 0.69).
